## Code Example

```sql
CREATE MASKING POLICY pii_mask
AS (val STRING) RETURNS STRING ->
  CASE
    WHEN CURRENT_USER() IN ('analyst@tenant-a.com') THEN val
    WHEN CURRENT_USER() IN ('analyst@tenant-b.com') THEN '***REDACTED***'
    ELSE '***MASKED***'
  END;

-- Row-Level Security via View
CREATE VIEW tenant_a.curated_orders AS
SELECT order_id, product_id, amount
FROM unified.orders
WHERE tenant_id = 'tenant-a';
```

## Why This Is Asked

## Code Example

```python
from pyspark.sql.functions import udf, col
from pyspark.sql.types import StringType

def mask_email(email):
    if email is None:
        return None
    user, domain = email.split('@', 1)
    return f'{user[0]}***@{domain}'
mask_udf = udf(mask_email, StringType())
df2 = df.withColumn('email_masked', mask_udf(col('email')))
```

## Why This Is Asked

## Code Example
```python
# PySpark code for flattening and upserting nested JSON
df = spark.read.json("abfss://container@storage.dfs.core.windows.net/input/")

flat_df = df.select(
    "timestamp",
    "metadata.source",
    "metadata.id",
    "data.nestedField1",
    "data.nestedField2"
)

flat_df.write.format("delta") \
    .mode("append") \
    .option("mergeSchema", "true") \
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.functions import col, when, sha2
```
